features.rationale: Rectangular plate; X is length, Y is height, and Z is thickness. Datum A is at Z=0.
First lower-row counterbored through hole, opening on datum A.
features.justification: End-view hidden lines establish the through bore and counterbore entry face. Bore depth exceeds plate thickness to ensure breakout; counterbore depth remains exact.

features.rationale: Five lower-row holes at baseline offsets 0, 20, 40, 60 and 80 inches.
First upper-row counterbored through hole at the printed 10-inch baseline offset.
features.justification: End view establishes through-bore geometry. Bore depth overshoots the back face; counterbore depth remains exact.

features.rationale: Four upper-row holes at baseline offsets 10, 30, 50 and 70 inches.
Confirm chamfer versus radius and select a size within .06/.09 for the two upper longitudinal edges.
features.justification: C/R does not uniquely specify a fillet rather than a chamfer. Operation and D020 size are placeholders only; do not execute until clarified.

notes: The nine holes form two staggered rows. Pattern geometry agrees with printed baseline dimensions D003 through D010; retain independent baseline tolerances rather than imposing chained pitch tolerances.
Datum A is the counterbore-side broad face at Z=0. The faint '- B' after the bore diameter is not treated as an established datum.
H-marked regions are heat-treatment extents, not steps: full top face and upper D018/D019 portions of both broad faces. Heat treatment specifies Rockwell C 58 minimum and D021 minimum hardened depth.
Material: MPR STD. STL.; exact grade requires the internal material specification.
Surface texture 16 and geometric tolerances are manufacturing/inspection requirements, not additional solid features.
The extraction's definite-radius interpretation of .06/.09 C/R requires clarification. Only the two indicated upper longitudinal edges are implicated.
